findings.label: composer.lock not checked in conditional install
findings.description: The entrypoint condition `[ composer.json -nt vendor/autoload.php ]` ignores composer.lock. A lockfile-only update (composer update) silently keeps a stale vendor directory. Fix: add `|| [ composer.lock -nt vendor/autoload.php ]` to the condition.

findings.label: config:cache / route:cache failures silently swallowed
findings.description: `2>/dev/null || true` suppresses all output from both artisan cache commands. A broken .env causes config:cache to fail silently; the server starts without the cache with no log entry. Remove the `2>/dev/null` redirect to surface failures in container logs while keeping `|| true` for graceful degradation.

findings.label: Route segment exports placed mid-import-block
findings.description: `export const revalidate = 300` in artigo/[slug]/page.tsx and `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` in busca/page.tsx are placed between import statements. Both work at runtime (ESM top-level) but confuse static analysis tools and import organizers. Move them after all imports.

findings.label: Search data cached 120 s despite force-dynamic
findings.description: busca/page.tsx sets `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` (correct for searchParams) but getArticles still passes `next: { revalidate: 120 }`, serving cached results for up to 2 minutes. If search freshness matters, use `cache: 'no-store'` instead or add a getArticlesNoCache variant for this call site.
